content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Breach
content_blocks.text: This Notice of Eviction is given due to the Tenant’s failure to comply with the terms of the lease agreement, specifically the requirement to pay rent on time.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Notice_Period
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to cure the breach or vacate the premises.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Termination
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant fails to cure the breach within the notice period, this lease agreement shall terminate immediately.
